title: Most Frequent K Values
prompt:
Given a slice of integers `nums` and a count `k`, return the k values that occur most often in nums. The answer is guaranteed to be unique (there are no ties at the k-th position). The returned values may be in any order.

Signature: `fn top_k_frequent(nums: &[i32], k: usize) -> Vec<i32>`

Try to do better than sorting all distinct values when k is small, for example with a `BinaryHeap`.

Example:
  top_k_frequent(&[5, 5, 5, 2, 2, 9], 2) -> [5, 2]   (any order)
